text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Spring Stakes behind her,<n>Rice Shower
carefully reviews her<n>results and vows to work
even<n>harder.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Mihono Bourbon's<n>speed
proved worthy of her<n>nickname, the Auburn Rocket.
The<n>crowd's ecstatic cheers echo<n>throughout the
track.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower can't stop working if<n>she hopes to
catch up to Mihono<n>Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She sets her sights on the Japanese<n>Derby and
begins training in earnest.
